name: Ion
source:
One of the angels who carries out the "apocalypse."
"An angel who prunes the possibilities of the mortal world."
She has a laid-back, fluffy, and easygoing personality.
She’s quite chatty and easy to converse with, but as an angel of the "apocalypse," she also has a cold side: she easily discards the weak without hesitation.
